description: Labeled eval set for tuning Stage 4's curriculum_match confidence-tier thresholds (rag_stage.decide_curriculum -> new_rag hybrid_retriever's HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INSUFFICIENT tiers). Built 2026-08-31 per real Class 10 CBSE ingested content (maths/science/social all confirmed to have real Qdrant content). Each case is a real, plausible student question with a ground-truth expected curriculum_match label, independent of any single model's guess.
